candidate_grammar.unique_survivor: CBLX-020 uniquely retains trace-or-relative-oracle-admissibility, complete self-application custody, root forcing, post-registry execution and no extra rule.

excluded_inputs: no axiom, imported computability theorem answer or target outcome selects the survivor
host absence and artifact counters are not admitted numerical-zero objects
no negative, irrational, imaginary, floating or completed-infinite proof scalar
no hidden transition, unregistered oracle, selected branch or stochastic cause

statement: A claimed computation beyond the admitted universal model is admissible only with a generated operational trace or a declared relative oracle record; an answer without either is not a computation and cannot enter the model.
title: Hypercomputation admissibility and physical-record boundary
